subject: Clarify rollback criteria & customer comm cadence for model cutover
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Acme Cloud SRE <eng-prod@acmecloud.com>

Subject: Clarify rollback criteria & customer comm cadence for model cutover

Team —

Quick context: Product is planning the model cutover that replaces the legacy v1 family with the v2-compat variants. Proposed cutover date is Oct 17 00:00 UTC (canary first). Before we lock the timeline I need the following clarified so we can finalize customer comms and exception gates: 

1) Concrete rollback thresholds (metrics & windows).
2) Exact canary window length and regional coverage.
3) Approved pre-notice and day-of comms cadence for customers (who writes/sends what).
4) Exception criteria for customers who need extra runway (how they apply + owner).

I attached the current cutover timeline and an early customer comm draft; please review and call out gaps. If we can get these answers by EOD Monday (Oct 5) I’ll push the customer 7-day pre-notice on Oct 10.

Attachments: [Attachment: cutover-timeline-v3.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks —
Avery
Avery Johnson
Product Manager, Serving
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Clarify rollback criteria & customer comm cadence for model cutover

On 2027-10-03 Avery Johnson wrote:
> Team —
>
> Quick context: Product is planning the model cutover that replaces the legacy v1 family with the v2-compat variants. Proposed cutover date is Oct 17 00:00 UTC (canary first). Before we lock the timeline I need the following clarified so we can finalize customer comms and exception gates: 
>
> 1) Concrete rollback thresholds (metrics & windows).
> 2) Exact canary window length and regional coverage.
> 3) Approved pre-notice and day-of comms cadence for customers (who writes/sends what).
> 4) Exception criteria for customers who need extra runway (how they apply + owner).

I can take point on (1) and (2). Proposal below (ops-side):

- Canary: 4-hour canary per region, start with us-west-2 only for day 0. If stable, widen to us-east-1 after 24 hours.
- Rollback thresholds (trigger automatic rollback):
  * error rate (5m moving average) > 0.5% for any model route
  * p95 latency degradation > 2x baseline (current baseline p95 ~380ms; trigger if >760–800ms sustained for 10m)
  * token-generation failures (internal exceptions) > 0.2% for 10m
- Manual rollback: ops on-call or product lead can trigger manual rollback for safety reasons outside metric triggers.
- Rollback action: switch routing back to pinned legacy variant + drain existing sessions; expected customer-visible regression for ~2–8 minutes during ramp down.

I attached the rollback-runbook draft; it includes the exact CLI steps and SRE owner list. We will need Marissa to sign off on customer messaging for the visible window that customers will see.

Attachment: [Attachment: rollback-runbook.md (MD)]

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior SRE, Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Park <eng-prod@acmecloud.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-04T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify rollback criteria & customer comm cadence for model cutover

Thanks for the heads up, Avery — appreciate the early coordination. A couple of asks from Acme SREs: 

- Can the day-0 canary be limited to us-west-2 and our internal test orgs first? We prefer a staged rollout (us-west-2 test orgs -> us-west-2 prod -> us-east-1 prod).
- We will need a 48-hour heads-up before the canary start for our on-call rotation and to validate our feature-flag hooks.
- One ask re: rollback: will Redwood surface an explicit feature-flag toggle (we can flip from our side) or will rollback be a platform-only route switch? Having a flag we control reduces coordination friction.

If you want, we can join a 30-min runbook dry-run with Marcus next week.

Jordan Park
Principal SRE, Acme Cloud
eng-prod@acmecloud.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Park <eng-prod@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2027-10-05T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify rollback criteria & customer comm cadence for model cutover — decisions & owners

Thanks everyone — consolidating decisions so we can finalize comms and gating: 

Decisions (agreed):
- Canary plan: Oct 17 00:00 UTC start, 4-hour us-west-2 canary limited to test orgs, widen to us-west-2 prod after 24h, then us-east-1 prod if no triggers.
- Rollback thresholds (auto): error rate >0.5% (5m avg); p95 > 2x baseline sustained 10m; token failures >0.2% (10m). Manual rollback authorized to SRE on-call + product lead.
- Rollback mechanism: platform route switch (Redwood) + optional customer feature-flag. Marcus: can you confirm by EOD Monday whether we can expose a customer-facing feature-flag toggle for Acme?
- Customer comms cadence: 7-day pre-notice (Oct 10), 48-hour SRE heads-up for partners (per Acme ask), day-of brief to ops list + in-product banner for affected routes, and a 24-hour post-mortem to customers. Marissa will own customer comm templates; I will own the internal cutover checklist and exceptions intake.
- Exceptions: customers can apply for a 30-day runway via the exceptions intake form; approvals routed to Product (Avery) + Sales (Marissa) + Security if needed.

Next steps / owners: 
- Marcus: confirm feature-flag feasibility and sign off on rollback-runbook (due 2027-10-09).
- Marissa: finalize customer-comm-draft.md and send to legal/PR for review (due 2027-10-09).
- Avery: finalize timeline and send pre-notice on Oct 10 if all done.
- Priya: will publish the internal playbook + exceptions intake doc and schedule a dry-run with Acme (Marcus + Jordan) next week.

Attachments included for review: [Attachment: customer-comm-draft.md], [Attachment: compatibility-matrix.xlsx]

Please ACK here when you have the owners' confirmation. If nothing else, I’ll assume tacit ACK by EOD Monday and proceed with the Oct 10 pre-notice.

—Priya
Priya Natarajan
Director, Product Ops
Redwood Inference
